description.value: A McDonald's fast food restaurant in North Vancouver serving burgers, chicken, breakfast, and McCafé beverages, with both drive-through and dine-in options available. The drive-through is noted in OSM as operating around the clock, making it a reliable stop for cyclists needing food at any hour. As part of the McDonald's Canada chain, it offers takeout and a broad menu including value meals and seasonal items.

raw_osm.note: Drive thru open 24/7, dine-in is tagged hours.
